author: Arnav
problem: Return the slideshow reordered so it starts k slides later than before, with the skipped slides moved to the end in their original order.
bug_description: Never reduces k modulo the number of slides, so when k is at least the number of slides the slices return the show unchanged.

comments.accurate: Rotates the slides so the show begins k slides later
comments.wrong_behavior: Rotates the slides left by k; a shift past the end of the show leaves the order as it is
comments.wrong_location: Rotation verified; check that a negative k moves the show the right way
